Zero Variance Guard (Z-score defaults to 0.0 when stddev < 0.0001)
nodes.rationale: In periods of stagnant rates (Fed funds pinned at target for months), standard deviation approaches zero causing NaN/Infinity z-scores. Guard prevents entire ILI from becoming undefined during calm regimes.
